results.question: Why schedule hot jobs during cooler parts of the day?
results.answer:
NIOSH general guidance: When possible, schedule hot jobs for the cooler part of the day (early morning, late afternoon, or night shift) and/or schedule hot jobs on alternate rather than succes - sive days.

This is general source guidance, not an assessment of worker safety or professional advice. For an emergency, contact local emergency medical services.
